metadata.title: 爱英TV 1520—1529地图细节：考古遗址、战争城镇、法英边防
metadata.guidance: Only draw sourced archaeological sites and modern locality references. Never infer continuous English territorial control from castle raids. Monasteroris religious house may differ from named Surrey-garrisoned castle. No geographic site from the 1530–1545 Guînes modern bastion map reverse-dated to 1529.
metadata.rights: coordinates derived from site gazetteers/official monument registries. No historic copyrighted maps copied or digitised.
metadata.editorial_review: Optional multi-site activity layer. Some points duplicate main event markers; show either research sites OR primary events to avoid overlap. Modern excavated settlement is historical geographic context only, not besieged site.

properties.title_zh: 1521 莫纳斯特罗里斯：防御修道院遭围攻
properties.site_identity_notes: Surviving ruin at graveyard; note 1550 survey recorded TWO separate castles and ruined friary. Cannot say friary exact = garrison castle.
properties.popup_zh: 1521年，英王总督围攻当地盖尔人用作堡垒的方济各会修道院，建筑严重受损。原址附近仍有遗迹；驻军城堡的准确身份继续核查。

properties.title_zh: 莫纳斯特罗里斯中世纪村落考古点
properties.site_identity_notes: SMR OF011-009006 and ITM E660737/N733226 record neighbouring deserted medieval settlement. 2010 excavation, NOT friary nor two identified 1550 castles.
properties.popup_zh: 2010年考古发现的中世纪村落地点，用来比对1521年战事周边地理，不应作为另一处已经证实的英军攻击点。

properties.title_zh: 1523 塞斯福德城堡：英军围城
properties.site_identity_notes: HES SM1710 NGR NT73759 23853; remains include possible English 1523 siegeworks. 1543/1544 subsequent damage excluded.
properties.popup_zh: 1523年，英军围攻苏格兰塞斯福德城堡。现存遗址的部分土工设施可能与此次围城有关，周边土地并未转为英王持续治理区。

properties.title_zh: 1523 费尼赫斯特城堡：攻取与拆毁
properties.site_identity_notes: HES LB13369 NT65235 17969. Current late 16th building incorporates earlier fabric; original 1523 demolished structure may differ.
properties.popup_zh: 1523年9月，英军在杰德堡附近攻取并拆毁费尼赫斯特城堡。萨里伯爵的当年战报记载守军抵抗及英军动用火炮。

properties.title_zh: 1523 杰德堡：城区遭英军焚毁
properties.site_identity_notes: Surrey original letter says town/towers burnt but abbey assault FAILED; avoid saying Jedburgh abbey destroyed in 1523 without contrary original verification.
properties.popup_zh: 1523年9月英军突袭并焚毁杰德堡市镇与防御塔。萨里伯爵的战报称修道院当时未能攻下；此战没有改变苏格兰的独立地位。

properties.title_zh: 1522 莫尔莱：英军劫掠并撤离
properties.site_identity_notes: City municipality dates early July. Coastal landing forest/river localities not geocoded separately; do not infer exact troop route or numbers.
properties.popup_zh: 1522年7月初，英国舰队袭击法国布列塔尼的莫尔莱，抢掠并焚毁城市建筑。当地民兵和增援部队随后反击。

properties.title_zh: 1529 吉讷：英王定居与租佃法规
properties.site_identity_notes: No 1529 maps of individual evicted tenants or direct-rule village boundaries; French culture p2 shows circa 1530-1545 bastions NOT within 1529.
properties.popup_zh: 1529年英王在吉讷边区推行定居法规，鼓励英格兰农民迁入，对法国和佛兰德居民的租佃与语言等作出限制。实际执行地点与人数仍待查。

properties.site_identity_notes: French Culture Ministry official archaeology p2 map labels French garrison Ardres and English Guînes.
properties.popup_zh: 阿德尔在本时期是法王控制的边境要塞，与英属吉讷隔境相望，不应涂成英国殖民地。
